description: Repuso connects ChatGPT to your review monitoring: fetch normalized reviews from 50+ platforms (Google, TripAdvisor, Trustpilot, G2, App Store and more), each with a sentiment label and on-the-fly translation. Ask for AI insights - what customers praise and what to fix - and AI review summaries per profile. Track official rating history, compare against competitor profiles you monitor, tag reviews for your workflows, and manage signed webhooks for new-review and rating-change events. Add profiles by business name or URL right from the chat. Every call runs on your own Repuso Monitoring API account - same key, quotas and pricing as the REST API. 10-day free trial, no card required.

defaultPrompt: Summarize sentiment across all my review profiles this month
Compare my rating against a competitor
